summary: Capital One Funding, LLC filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for an $850,000,000 tranche of Class A(2026-3) Card series notes issued by the Capital One Multi-asset Execution Trust. The notes carry a 5.22% annual coupon, priced at 99.98404% for proceeds of roughly $847.7 million after a 0.25% underwriting discount. Interest pays monthly from November 2026, with an expected principal payment date of September 17, 2029 and legal maturity September 15, 2031. J.P. Morgan, Morgan Stanley and Scotiabank are joint bookrunners. This is routine credit-card ABS issuance, not a special situation.
